name: Vrock

actions.name: Stunning Screech
actions.effect: All creatures within 6m must pass PHYS save or be stunned until end of their next turn. Usable once per encounter.

actions.name: Spores
actions.effect: A 5m radius cloud of toxic spores. Targets must pass PHYS save or take damage and be poisoned. While poisoned, they take 1d8 poison at the start of each turn for 1 minute.

reactions.name: Wing Buffet
reactions.effect: When a creature enters melee range, the Vrock beats its wings. Target must pass PHYS save or be pushed 3m and knocked prone.

traits.name: Flyby
traits.desc: Can fly. Does not provoke reactions when flying out of an enemy's reach.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: +1d6 to saves against spells and magical effects.

lore: Vrocks are vulture-headed demons that revel in carnage and destruction. They attack in shrieking dives, releasing clouds of toxic spores and ear-splitting screeches. In groups, they perform a horrific dance that unleashes devastating energy.
